Descrição detalhada

Path manager for CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) with visualization, simulation and path generation capabilities. Handles the generation, visualization, and simulation of inspection paths for 3D CAD models.

◆ RebuildInPathBridges()

void HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.PathManager.RebuildInPathBridges ( HashSet< Color >? movedColors = null)
private

Rebuilds bridge segments that are embedded mid-path (when multiple parts share a single ColorPath, i.e. same scan color). After a part move, non-bridge points are translated but the old bridge points retain stale positions; this method removes them and re-interpolates new bridges between the adjacent non-bridge runs.

bool HirEV_SmartFitSystemsApp.Utilities.PathManager.hasCollision

Tests collision detection for a specific path segment with detailed output.

Checks collision between a segment and a Brep solid using mesh conversion and intersection. This is the primary method for path planning collision detection.

startStart point of segment
endEnd point of segment

Tuple of (hasCollision, collisionPoint)

segmentStartStart point of the segment
